description: C3 freeze contract — the single human-readable record of every value pinned at D2-entry. This file is DOCUMENTATION, not enforcement: the actual gates live in the cited source files + CI jobs. Its purpose is to give the D2 playthrough debrief one artifact to cite when logging any hash/schema drift surfaced during play. NOTE: the full-save byte hash is platform-divergent (Win dev vs Linux CI float serialization) and is DELIBERATELY NOT pinned — only platform-stable integer/control-map signals are frozen. Any change to a frozen value requires a deliberate --update (or schema bump + migration) and panel sign-off; it is never a silent drift.
road_to_1_0: §6-symmetry CLOSED (panel-confirmed) -> C3 freeze (this file) -> D2 owner full-campaign playthrough (the sole 1.0 blocker, travel-blocked) -> D3 -> 1.0.

schema.note: tg_schema_freeze.test.ts pins CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION === getLatestSchemaVersion() === 36 and (C3) the canonical persisted key-sets of military/political/displacement. A new persisted field without a migration + schema bump trips a RED required test (full-suite CI). The startup-snapshot contract (tests/startup_snapshot_contract.test.ts) is the second layer.

calibration_40w.enforced_by: structural-fingerprint CI job (REQUIRED) via npm run ci:structural-fingerprint:check; drift = hard fail; deliberate change = npm run ci:structural-fingerprint:update + panel sign-off
calibration_40w.note: Schema v2 fingerprints sorted OSID flip rows as well as per-faction counts, anchors, benchmarks, and run shape; equal-count control swaps are no longer invisible to the CI gate.

calibration_188w.note: The 188w control_delta is platform-stable but byte-pinned only via the matched_osids_floor integer (622 after the 2026-07-17 campaign-QA organizational-policy re-floor), not a manifest SHA. The 188w final_save_hash is retained for lineage only and is NOT a CI gate (platform-divergent). The canon-corrected endpoint passes all 31 anchors, including Brcko city and corridor.

engine_health_188w.enforced_by: engine-health-188w CI job — REQUIRED + blocking (promoted from advisory 2026-06-13, owner-authorized: continue-on-error removed #430 + added to main branch-protection required checks). A hard 188w regression now BLOCKS merge on sim-touching PRs; doc/CI PRs pass via the always-report green-fast shim (verified: #431 reported green-fast pass on a CI-only PR).

golden_manifest.enforced_by: npm run test:baselines (scenarios CI job) — SHA-256 byte-identity on Linux CI for control_delta/formation_delta/final_save/run_summary per scenario

startup_snapshot.enforced_by: tests/startup_snapshot_contract.test.ts (full-suite CI, REQUIRED) — byte-for-byte vs the canonical builder truth
